_comment: Cards that exist only for the activation prohibition test (tests/unit/statics/test_cant_activate_abilities.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_abolisher` is Grand Abolisher's second half and Myrel's first line -- opponents can't activate abilities of artifacts, creatures or enchantments they control, during its controller's turn. `t_quiet_abolisher` drops the turn condition so the lock can be measured inside the opponent's own priority window without driving a turn. The permanents whose abilities are under test are the shared ones in testing.cards.json -- t_mutator, t_bobblehead, t_sac_outlet, t_dork and t_passage -- the way test_cant_cast_spells.py reuses t_dork and t_bear.
